mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during the identified inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 130,000 monthly suggests labor market strength that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are negative or flat despite sustained PAYEMS above threshold (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 85) indicates weakening supply-side conditions, which typically precedes equity risk premium expansion and drives negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: More than 60% of INDPRO contractions are followed by non-negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K indicates renewed demand for capital goods and consumer confidence, generating a positive S&P 5-day forward return.
failure_condition: Over 1000 observed HOUST up moves fail to produce positive 5-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for two consecutive months, the persistent higher discount rate suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During high-rate periods, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of unemployment rate falling below 5% (UNRATE < 5) signals labor market resilience, which amplifies equity risk premium and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative despite sustained UNRATE below 5 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in retail sales proxy RSAFS by more than 10% in a month is interpreted as demand shock, resulting in negative S&P 20-day forward returns due to market uncertainty.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls >10% in a single month
failure_condition: During similar shocks, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between falling industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) creates a supply-demand imbalance that predicts negative S&P 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 50% of such dual events produce non-negative 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05).
